DetailHandoff

Privacy Policy

Effective September 12, 2026

DetailHandoff is a local-first vehicle documentation app. This policy explains what information the app stores, when information may leave the app, and the choices available to you.

Information stored by the app

DetailHandoff may store the information you enter or create, including:

  • Business profile, branding, service, and capture-template settings.
  • Customer names and optional contact details.
  • Vehicle, plate, color, service, location, notes, workflow state, and timestamps.
  • Before and After photos, thumbnails, capture metadata, and condition findings.
  • Customer name, acknowledgment, signature strokes, or a reason the customer was unavailable.
  • Generated PDF reports, report revisions, integrity hashes, backups, and deletion metadata.

Core records and files are stored in the app’s local container on your device. DetailHandoff does not require an account.

Camera and photo selection

Camera access is requested when you choose to take a vehicle photo. Photo imports use Apple’s system photo picker, which allows you to select specific images. DetailHandoff does not intentionally save captured or imported evidence back to your Photos library.

Network, analytics, and advertising

The current version of DetailHandoff has no developer-operated backend, login service, analytics SDK, advertising SDK, third-party runtime SDK, or automatic CloudKit database sync. The app does not use your information for advertising or tracking.

When information leaves the app

Information may leave the app when you deliberately use an export or operating-system feature, including:

  • Sharing a report PDF through the system share sheet.
  • Exporting a job’s photo package to a location you select.
  • Creating a full backup in Files or another destination you select.
  • Restoring a backup package you select.

After a file is handed to Files, iCloud Drive, email, messaging, an external drive, or another share destination, that provider controls its copies, security, and retention under its own settings and policies.

Device backups

DetailHandoff does not initiate remote backups. Depending on your Apple device and backup settings, an iCloud Backup or computer backup may include app data. Apple or the backup provider controls those system-level backups.

Retention and deletion

  • Active records remain on your device until you delete them.
  • Deleted jobs can remain recoverable in Recently Deleted for up to 30 days unless you permanently remove them sooner.
  • Copies you previously exported or shared are not removed when you delete the corresponding app record.
  • Uninstalling the app or losing, erasing, or damaging the device may permanently remove local data unless a usable app backup or system backup exists.

Security and integrity

DetailHandoff relies on the app sandbox provided by Apple’s operating system and validates internal, export, and restore paths. SHA-256 hashes are used to help detect changes to report and backup assets. A hash is an integrity check; it is not encryption or a digital signature.

Children’s privacy

DetailHandoff is a professional vehicle-documentation tool and is not directed to children. The app does not knowingly collect information from children through a developer-operated service.

Changes to this policy

If DetailHandoff’s data practices change, this policy will be updated and the effective date shown above will be revised.

Contact

Questions about this policy or DetailHandoff’s privacy practices can be sent to aiden609906@gmail.com.
